archetypes.name: dyn-cap-policy
archetypes.rationale: Review cap policy now spans runtime clamping, continuation reasons, and fixtures.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the review-round cap changes across difficulty resolution and plan-review continuation. Check that stale persisted HARD cap records cannot authorize an extra round, while duplicate-finding convergence still reports the intended reason. Pay special attention to off-by-one behavior at review_count 1 and 2. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
